name: Stonefire Original Naan Flatbread
whyItWorks: Authentic tandoor-oven baked flatbread made with enriched flour, cultured buttermilk, and ghee. Soft, bubbly, and tender with zero coarse grains or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm in a 400°F oven for 2 minutes or skillet-warm with a tiny touch of butter.
